DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩する場所をお探しですか。案内図の展望場所を見ていらっしゃいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to rest? I see you are looking at the viewpoint on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近そうなので、そこで座って休めると思いました。今日は階段を上がらずに休みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 近い展望場所で座れると思ったが階段を使わず休みたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It seemed close, so I thought I could sit and rest there. Today I would like to rest without climbing stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought you could sit at the nearby viewpoint but want to rest without stairs. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展望場所という表示だけでは休憩の設備は分かりません。道の階段表示も見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The label ‘viewpoint’ alone does not tell us about rest facilities. Let us also check the stair markings along the route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この道には階段の印がありますね。展望場所はやめて、平らな道の先の休憩場所を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段印を見て展望場所をやめ平らな道先の休憩所を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: This path has a stair symbol. I will skip the viewpoint and look for a rest area along a level path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice the stair symbol, give up the viewpoint, and look for a rest area along a level path. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図の休憩表示を確かめましょう。今いるところから戻る方向も見ておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the rest area markings. Shall we also check the direction back from your current location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見たいです。休んだ後に入口へ戻るので、同じ道を戻れる場所がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩後は入口へ戻るため同じ道を戻れる場所を選びたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will return to the entrance after resting, so I prefer somewhere I can return along the same path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want somewhere you can retrace the path because you will return to the entrance after resting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分岐の手前にある場所から確認しましょう。席が埋まっている場合もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us first check the place before the junction. The seats may all be occupied.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 空席がなければ、別の場所を求めて階段へ進まず、入口のほうへ戻って休む方法を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 階段の先へ探しに行かず入口側へ戻って休む方法を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If there are no empty seats, I will consider returning toward the entrance to rest rather than going up the stairs to search elsewhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider returning toward the entrance to rest instead of searching beyond the stairs. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行く距離を短くできますね。ご一緒の方には希望を伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That can shorten your walk. Have you told your companion what you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人は展望場所へ行くつもりです。私は平らな道の休憩場所へ行くと伝え、分かれる前に戻る場所をそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人へ平坦な休憩場所の希望を伝え分かれる前に帰る場所を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend plans to visit the viewpoint. I will say I am going to the rest area on the level path, and we will agree where to return before separating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your friend you prefer the level rest area and agree where to return before parting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、階段と休憩の表示を確認してお進みください。休みながら、よい散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the stair and rest area signs as you go. Enjoy your walk, taking rests along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換のご相談ですね。目的地の情報を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about transfers. Could you show me the information about your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講習会へ行きます。会場名で調べましたが、同じ名前の場所が二つ出てきて、どちらへ向かうか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会場名だけで調べた経路の目的地を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to a training session. I searched by the venue name, but two places with the same name appeared, and I do not know which to head for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the destination of a route searched using only the venue name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会場名だけで決めず、招待状の住所を照らしましょう。住所のある案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the address on the invitation rather than deciding by the venue name alone. Do you have information showing the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 招待状を携帯電話で見られます。自分が調べた経路の住所とは、町の名前が違っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 招待状と検索した場所の町名が違うと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see the invitation on my phone. The town name differs from the address on the route I found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the town name on the invitation differs from the place found in your search. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず招待状の目的地を確かめましょう。以前に調べた経路は、その確認が済むまで使わないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us first confirm the destination on the invitation. Do not use the route you found before until that is checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会場の担当へ住所を確認します。経路を聞くときは、会場名だけでなく住所も見せればよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当へ住所を聞いて経路相談に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will confirm the address with the venue staff. When asking about the route, I should show the address as well as the venue name, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff for the address and show it when requesting route advice. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、目的地がわかったら最寄りの駅と乗換の候補を確認できます。現在の列車案内とも照らしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Once the destination is clear, we can check the nearest station and transfer options. Let us also compare current train information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最寄り駅と会場までの道も別に知りたいです。列車を降りたら到着ではないので、その後の案内も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最寄り駅と降車後の道をそれぞれ知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to know the nearest station and the route to the venue separately. Getting off the train is not arrival at the venue, so I will check the directions afterward too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to know the nearest station and the route after getting off separately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 招待状の徒歩経路なども確認してください。こちらでは列車の候補を案内し、会場への道は会場側の情報とも照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check any walking route on the invitation. We can explain train options here and compare the way to the venue with information from its staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会場の住所を担当に聞き、正しい最寄り駅までの乗換を相談します。駅から会場の道も確かめてから向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい住所と駅と乗換と徒歩経路をそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the venue staff for the address and discuss transfers to the correct nearest station. I will also check the route from the station to the venue before heading out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the correct address, station, transfers, and walking route. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 出発前に場所の違いに気づけましたね。住所の確認が取れたら、招待状を見せてください。それでは、よい講習になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You noticed the different locations before leaving. Once the address is confirmed, please show me the invitation. I hope the training goes well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 指定された証明書についてですね。案内のどの部分がわかりにくいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: About the specified certificate: which part of the instructions is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出先が指定した年度と、説明にある収入の年が違います。誤りなのかと思い、どちらを頼むか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指定年度と収入の年が違う証明書を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The fiscal year specified by the receiving organization differs from the income year in the explanation. I wondered whether it was an error and do not know which to request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a certificate whose specified fiscal year differs from its income year. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 年度の表示と対象の期間を分けて確認しましょう。案内を省略せず見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the fiscal year label separately from the covered period. Could you show the instructions without omitting anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらが全文です。年の数字だけ抜き出してメモしたので、何の年なのか区別できなくなっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数字だけのメモで年の意味を失ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the full text. I wrote down only the year numbers, so I lost track of what each year referred to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that copying only the numbers made the meaning of the years unclear. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 証明書の種類によって表示の意味を確認する必要があります。担当が案内と対象期間を照らします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The meaning of the labels needs checking according to the certificate type. The staff member will compare the instructions and covered period.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で新しい年に変えず、指定された年度の意味を聞きたいです。提出先に確かめる項目も教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定の意味と提出先への質問を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not want to change it to a newer year myself; I would like to ask what the specified fiscal year means. Could you also tell me what to confirm with the receiving organization?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the meaning of the specification and what to ask the receiving organization. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類名、指定年度、必要な対象期間を確認しましょう。本人だけの証明かどうかも案内を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the document name, specified fiscal year, and required covered period. Also look at whether the instructions require a certificate only for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人だけと書かれています。年度が違うように見えた理由がわかるまで、申請の欄を選ばずに相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人分と示し年度確認まで申請欄を選ばない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It says only for me. Until I understand why the years appeared different, I will seek advice without selecting an application field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain it is for you alone and do not select an application field until the year is checked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認後に担当窓口で申請の方法をご案内します。料金や持ち物も、選ぶ種類に合わせて確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: After that is checked, the responsible counter will explain how to apply. Let us also check the fees and required items for the selected type.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全文を見せ、年度と対象期間を分けて聞きます。本人分の指定を伝え、種類が決まってから申請の持ち物と料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 年度と対象期間と本人指定を確かめ種類に合う準備をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the full text and ask separately about the fiscal year and covered period. I will explain the requirement for my own certificate and check what to bring and the fee after the type is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the fiscal year, period, and personal certificate requirement and prepare for that type. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内の意味を確かめる相談として承りました。担当へ全文とメモをお持ちください。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have noted your request to clarify the instructions. Please bring the full text and your note to the staff member. Thank you for consulting us today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手の感覚についてお話ししたいとのことですね。問診票にわからない言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to talk about the sensation in your hand. Are there words on the medical questionnaire you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「しびれ」と書いてあります。痛みと同じ意味なのか、自分の感じをどう書くのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: しびれと痛みが同じ意味かを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says ‘numbness.’ I am unsure whether that means the same as pain or how to write what I feel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether numbness and pain mean the same thing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ言葉と決めず、ご自身が感じた様子をお話しください。どんな感じに近いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Without assuming they mean the same thing, please describe your own sensation. What does it feel most like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 強く痛むより、指先がぴりぴりする感じです。物に触った感じも、いつもと違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指先のぴりぴりと触覚の普段との違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Rather than strong pain, it feels like tingling in my fingertips. The sensation when touching things was different from usual too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe tingling in the fingertips and a difference in touch from usual. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その言葉で担当へ伝えましょう。気づいたときや、今も感じるかは説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell the staff member in those words. Can you explain when you noticed it and whether you still feel it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の作業の後に気づきましたが、何時かは覚えていません。今は昨日ほど気にならないものの、完全になくなったか自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作業後に気づいたが時刻と現在の程度は曖昧と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I noticed after work yesterday, but I do not remember what time. It bothers me less now than yesterday, but I am not sure it has gone completely.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you noticed after work but the time and present extent are unclear. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 覚えていない時刻と、今の感じの不確かさも分けて伝えてください。どちらの手かはわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Explain the forgotten time separately from your uncertainty about the present feeling. Do you know which hand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右手です。どの指かを番号で言うより、手を示して説明したいです。見てもらいながら話せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 右手の指を言葉の番号だけでなく示して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My right hand. Rather than identifying the fingers only by numbers, I would like to point at my hand. Can I talk while you look?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate the fingers of your right hand rather than describing them only by numbers. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 示していただいて構いません。問診票へどう記入するかも、担当に相談する内容として引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may point. I will also pass on your question about how to complete the questionnaire for discussion with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右手を示して、昨日の作業後のぴりぴりした感じを説明します。時刻と今の感じははっきりしないと伝え、記入を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部位と感じと不明な時刻や現状を区別し記入を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show my right hand and explain the tingling after yesterday's work. I will say the time and present feeling are unclear and ask how to fill it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the location, sensation, unclear time, and current uncertainty and ask how to complete the form. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身の言葉で伺えました。担当へつなぎますので、問診票とお手元の資料をお持ちください。ご説明いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have explained it in your own words. I will refer you to the staff member, so please bring the questionnaire and any materials you have. Thank you for explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お仕事の登録に関する連絡が不安とのことですね。経緯をお話しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are worried about a message concerning job registration. Could you explain what happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 求人に応募した後、別の名前の相手から登録を急ぐよう連絡が来ました。応募先と同じ相手かわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別名の相手と応募先の関係がわからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: After applying for a job, someone with a different name contacted me urging registration. I do not know whether they are the same party I applied to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know the connection between the differently named sender and the organization you applied to. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 応募した案内と届いた連絡を分けて確認しましょう。どちらも残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the job advertisement and the received message separately. Do you still have both?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 求人の案内とメッセージを残しています。相手には名前と電話番号を送りましたが、登録の画面にはまだ進んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 求人とメッセージを残し名前と番号だけ送ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I kept the advertisement and message. I sent my name and phone number, but have not proceeded to the registration screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you kept the advertisement and message and sent only your name and number. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送った情報と、行っていない操作を確認しました。ほかに求められた情報や金額の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked the information sent and the operations not performed. Were other information or any amounts requested?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人確認の画像を求められましたが送っていません。お金については書かれているか、まだ全文を読めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認画像は送らず金額の記載は未確認と知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They requested an identity verification image, but I have not sent one. I have not read the full text yet, so I have not checked whether money is mentioned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not sent an identity image and have not checked whether an amount is mentioned. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読める範囲を一緒に確認し、不明な部分は不明と残しましょう。相手が応募先と関係するかも、今ここで決めつけず確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check what we can read together and leave unknown parts marked as unknown. We will also check their connection with the employer rather than deciding here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡を消さず、応募先への確認も相談したいです。メッセージの中の新しい連絡先だけを使ってよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 削除せず新しい連絡先だけで確認することに疑問を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the message and would like advice on checking with the organization I applied to. I am unsure whether to use only the new contact details in the message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not delete it and question using only the new contact details to verify. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ確認の方法を相談しましょう。応募時に使った案内も提示し、連絡先の違いがわかるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us ask the staff member about verification methods. Show the original application advertisement too so the difference in contact details is clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 応募の案内と届いた文、送った名前と番号を見せます。画像は未送信で、全文の不明点と確認方法を担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの案内と送信情報と不明点を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the advertisement, received message, and the name and number I sent. I have not sent the image and will ask the staff member about unclear text and verification methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss the two notices, information sent, and unknown points separately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 情報を分けて伝えてくださり、ありがとうございます。担当へご案内しますので、二つの案内をお手元に置いてお待ちください。それでは、引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for separating the information. I will refer you to the staff member, so please keep both notices at hand while waiting. I will now hand this over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本をまとめてお送りになるのですね。梱包した状態を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending books together. Let us check their packaged condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きな箱に入れました。小さい箱へ替えれば、重さも減って費用が下がると思ったのですが、どう相談すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小箱へ替えると重さや費用が減るか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put them in a large box. I thought changing to a small box would reduce the weight and cost, but how should I ask about that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether changing to a small box reduces weight or cost. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱の寸法と重さを分けて確認します。本自体の重さもあるので、箱の見た目だけでは条件を決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We check box dimensions and weight separately. The books themselves have weight, so the appearance of the box alone cannot determine the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本が重いことを忘れていました。箱を替える前に、今の状態の寸法と重さで候補を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本の重さも考え今の梱包で候補を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I forgot that the books are heavy. Before changing boxes, I would like options based on the present dimensions and weight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Consider the books' weight and ask for options for the current packaging. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認した状態で候補をご案内します。小さい箱に詰め直す場合も、中身が収まるかや梱包の状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain options for the condition checked. If repacking into a small box, also check that the contents fit and the packaging is suitable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 無理に押し込むのはやめます。本の角を守るための詰め物が入っていることも、伝えたほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無理に詰めず角を守る梱包も説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not force them in. I should also mention the cushioning to protect the corners of the books, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid forcing them in and describe packaging that protects their corners. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身と梱包の状態を具体的に伝えてください。詰め直した場合は、発送する実際の状態で改めて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Describe the contents and packaging specifically. If you repack, we will check again in the actual condition to be shipped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日持ってきた箱の状態と、家で替える案を混ぜずに聞きます。どちらも確認が済んでから費用を比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参箱と変更案それぞれの確認後に費用を比べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask about the box I brought separately from the plan to change it at home. I want to compare costs after both are checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare costs after separately checking the current box and proposed change. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件をそろえて比べましょう。今の相談だけでは発送を受け付けたわけではないので、送り出す日も確認後に決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us compare under matching conditions. This discussion alone does not mean the shipment has been accepted, so decide the shipping date after checking too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本と詰め物の内容を伝え、寸法と重さを測って方法を比べます。小さい箱だから安いと決めず、実際の状態で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 具体的内容と実測で方法を比べ箱の見た目で決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will describe the books and cushioning, measure the dimensions and weight, and compare methods. I will ask based on the actual condition without assuming a smaller box is cheaper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare methods using specific contents and actual measurements, not the box's appearance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 比較に必要な情報が整理できました。まず持参した箱を確認しますね。発送前にお立ち寄りいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have organized the information needed for comparison. Let us first check the box you brought. Thank you for stopping by before shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の操作後の画面についてですね。どの表示が気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: About the screen after your transfer operation: which display concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 操作の後に「予約」と出ました。送金が済んだと思ってよいのか、もう一度操作すべきか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送金完了か再操作が必要か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: After the operation it said ‘scheduled.’ I do not know whether the money has been sent or I should perform the operation again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the transfer is complete or another operation is necessary. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示だけを見て再操作せず、記録の状態を担当へ確認しましょう。画面と案内を残していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not repeat the operation based only on the display; ask the staff member to check the record status. Have you kept the screen and instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面を残しています。日付の欄もありますが、操作した日なのか、振込の予定日なのか読み方がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面を残し日付が操作日か予定日か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I kept the screen. There is a date field, but I cannot tell whether it is the operation date or scheduled transfer date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you kept the screen and ask whether the date is the operation date or scheduled date. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日付の意味と処理の状態を照らします。宛先と金額も、元の案内と比べておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will compare the date meaning with the processing status. Also compare the destination and amount with the original instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の振込先の案内を持っています。金額のほかに費用も表示されていますが、いつ引かれるのか担当に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込先案内を提示し費用が引かれる時点を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the original transfer instructions. A fee is shown as well as the amount, and I want to ask the staff member when it will be deducted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the transfer instructions and ask when the fee will be deducted. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も含めて担当が確認します。予約済み、実行済み、まだ必要な操作などを分けて案内してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check that too. Ask them to explain separately what is scheduled, what is completed, and any operations still required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかるまで同じ振込をやり直しません。相手にも、画面を見ただけで送金完了とは伝えず、確認中だと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 状態確認までやり直さず相手へ確認中と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not repeat the same transfer until I understand. I will tell the recipient it is being checked rather than claiming it is complete just from seeing the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not repeat until the status is checked and tell the recipient you are checking. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた状態を伝えてください。担当から説明を受けたら、今後の確認方法も聞いておくとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Communicate the status that has been confirmed. After the staff member explains it, it is also useful to ask how to check it in future.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約の状態と日付、宛先と金額と費用を聞きます。必要な操作と完了の確認方法を確かめ、同じ振込を重ねません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約と日付と宛先と費用と完了確認を分けて聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask about the schedule status, date, destination, amount, and fee. I will check the necessary operation and how to confirm completion, without duplicating the transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask separately about scheduling, date, destination, fees, and completion checks. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録を残してご相談いただけましたね。担当に確認する間、画面と案内をお手元に置いてお待ちください。それでは、引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You kept the record for this consultation. Please keep the screen and instructions at hand while I check with the staff member. I will now hand this over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋も必要でしたね。お支払い前に合計をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You needed a bag too. Please check the total before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋を含むと予算を超えそうです。まだ支払っていないので、商品を一つ戻して合計を見直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払い前に商品を外して合計を見直す相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Including the bag may exceed my budget. Since I have not paid yet, can we remove one item and recalculate the total?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to remove an item and review the total before paying. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更を確認します。どの商品を外したいか示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the change. Could you point out which item to remove?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この菓子を外したいです。残りは持参袋へ入るか確かめ、入るなら購入する袋も不要にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 菓子を外し持参袋に収まるなら袋購入もやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to remove these sweets. I will check whether the rest fits my own bag, and if it does, I do not want to buy a bag either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Remove the sweets and cancel the bag purchase if the remainder fits your own bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品と袋の変更をそれぞれ確認しましょう。袋が不要なら、その希望も会計前に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the item change and bag change separately. If no bag is needed, tell us before checkout too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持参袋へ入りそうなので、追加の袋は要りません。変更後の合計を教えていただけますか。確認してから支払いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加袋を不要と伝え変更後の総額を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It looks like it fits my own bag, so I do not need an additional bag. Could you tell me the revised total? I want to check before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say an additional bag is unnecessary and ask for the revised total. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更後の合計を確認します。支払方法のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the new total. Do you have a preferred payment method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現金で払う予定です。手元の金額で足りるか確かめてから渡したいので、少し待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手元の現金が足りるか確かめてから払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to pay cash. Please wait a little because I want to check that the money I have is enough before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that the cash you have is sufficient before paying. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認をお待ちします。支払いを始める前に、外した商品と袋が合計に残っていないかも見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will wait while you check. Before starting payment, also check that the removed item and bag are no longer in the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 菓子と袋を外した合計を見て、手元の現金で払います。残りは持参袋に入れ、支払い後のレシートも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品と袋の除外を見て現金で払いレシートを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the total without the sweets and bag and pay with my cash. I will put the rest in my own bag and check the receipt after paying too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the item and bag have been removed, pay cash, and check the receipt. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 変更のご希望を確認しました。新しい合計をご案内してからお会計を進めます。お買い物いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed your requested changes. We will tell you the new total before proceeding with payment. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内を歩くご予定ですね。コースを選ぶ際に気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You plan to walk in the park. Is there anything that concerns you when choosing a route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日なたを長く歩くと疲れるので、日陰で休める短い道を探しています。図だけでは日陰の場所がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日なたで疲れるため日陰のある短い道を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Walking a long time in the sun tires me, so I am looking for a short path where I can rest in shade. The map alone does not show where the shade is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a short path with shade because sunny walking tires you. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 休憩場所の候補は確認できますが、日陰の状態は時間でも変わります。現地の様子を見ながら範囲を考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can check possible rest areas, but shade changes with the time. Let us consider your range while checking actual conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 図に木が描いてあるから必ず日陰だとは思わないようにします。近い休憩候補を先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 木の絵だけで判断せず近い休憩候補を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not assume there is always shade just because a tree is drawn on the map. Please first tell me nearby rest options.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not judge only from tree drawings; ask about nearby rest options. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 近い候補を示します。そこまでの道と、入口へ戻る道を一緒に見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will show nearby options. Let us look together at the path there and the path back to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休む所が日なたなら、さらに遠い場所へ探しに行かず戻りたいです。途中から戻れる経路も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休めなければ遠い日陰を探さず引き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the rest area is sunny, I would like to return rather than search farther away. Can we also check a route to turn back partway?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Turn back if you cannot rest rather than searching for distant shade. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻る候補を確認しましょう。疲れを感じたら先へ進むことにこだわらず、歩く範囲を短くしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check return options. If you feel tired, shorten the walk instead of insisting on continuing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は遠くの一周コースではなく、近い区間を往復する案にします。入口の休める場所も最後に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一周をやめ入口の休める場所も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I will go back and forth along a nearby stretch instead of taking the distant loop. Finally, I would also like to check a rest area at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give up the loop and also check a place to rest at the entrance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口周辺の利用できる場所も現地で確かめましょう。日陰を探すために通路以外へ入らず、表示を見て歩いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check available places near the entrance on site too. Do not leave the paths to search for shade; walk while following the signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 候補の休憩場所と途中の帰路を確認し、日陰は実際に見て判断します。休めなければ遠くへ行かず入口に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実際の日陰と表示を見て休めなければ入口へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the possible rest area and return routes along the way and judge shade by seeing it. If I cannot rest, I will return to the entrance rather than going farther.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check actual shade and signs, and return to the entrance if you cannot rest. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日の様子に合わせて歩ける案になりましたね。表示を確かめながら、短い散歩をお楽しみください。それでは、お気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40223-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That plan lets you adjust to today's conditions. Check the signs and enjoy a short walk. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅れの表示のほかに、行き先の欄も変わっています。最終的にはどちらまでお越しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: As well as a delay notice, the destination field has changed. Where is your final destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内紙の終点まで行く予定です。遅れてもこの便に乗り続ければ着くと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内紙の終点へ行き遅れだけ待てば同便で着くと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to go to the terminus on the information sheet. I thought I would arrive by staying on this service even if it was delayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you are going to the listed terminus and thought waiting through the delay would get you there on the same service. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用画面では、今回は途中の停車駅までの運行と書かれています。遅れの分だけ待つ話とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this practice screen, it says the service runs only as far as an intermediate stop this time. That is different from simply waiting out a delay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中で運行が終わるのですね。その先へ行く方法は、この画面だけではわからないということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 途中駅で終わると確認し先の移動は画面だけでは不明か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the service ends partway. Does that mean this screen alone does not tell me how to go farther?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm it ends at an intermediate stop and ask whether onward travel is unclear from the screen alone. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その先の案内はまだ出ていません。今ある情報で、この便が終点まで行くとは判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: No onward information has appeared yet. Do not conclude from the information available that this service goes to the terminus.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 終点まで行くとは考えず待ちます。途中駅まで乗るか、ここに残るかを決める前に、次の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 終点行きと思わず途中へ乗るか残るかの前に次の案内を聞きたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait without assuming it reaches the terminus. Before deciding whether to ride to the intermediate stop or remain here, I would like the next announcement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume it reaches the terminus; ask for the next information before deciding whether to ride partway or stay. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どちらを選ぶかは今ここで勧め切れません。目的地と予定を相談できるようにしておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I cannot fully recommend either option here now. Be ready to discuss your destination and plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 目的地で借りた物を返す予定があります。先方には、移動方法をまだ確認中だと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 借用品の返却予定があり先方に移動方法確認中と伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to return something borrowed at the destination. I would like to tell the other person I am still checking how to travel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you plan to return a borrowed item and want to tell the other person you are checking transport. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確定していないことを伝える案ですね。案内の更新は、遅れと行き先の両方を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your plan is to explain what remains uncertain. For updates, check both delays and destinations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先方へ到着を約束せず、確認中だと連絡します。次の案内で行き先と利用区間を見てから乗るか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着を約束せず先方へ確認中と知らせ更新の行き先区間を見て乗車を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them I am checking, without promising arrival. I will decide whether to board after checking the destination and service section in the next information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not promise arrival, tell them you are checking, and decide boarding after the updated destination and section. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、運行の案内を確認しながらお待ちください。移動の予定が整いましたら、お気をつけてお出掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait while checking service announcements. Once your travel plan is arranged, have a safe trip.
